ChangeRequest.name: AE Requirements - Fiduciary Instrument - (FDCRY)
ChangeRequest.comment:
An indicator specifying if an instrument is a fiduciary instrument or not. Currently in the LDM there's an entity _Fiduciary instrument type_, with attribute `Fiduciary instrument indicator`, related only to the entities _Deposit_ and _Other loan_.
In AE this concept is required in template F 32.01 and it is needed/relevant for loans and advances, equity instruments (both those which are securities and those which aren't), and debt securities (both negotiable and not negotiable) to cover the columns about Assets '**_which are issued by other entities of the group_**'.
